title: Generate verification assets for fifo_v3 semantic defects
claims: This draft asks for independently authored simulation and formal verification assets for the pinned fifo_v3 DUT.
The workflow receives only the pinned DUT, its license notice, and independently worded public contracts.
excluded_claims: The upstream fifo_tb, upstream property file, formal script, hidden mutants, evaluator harnesses, and calibration solutions are not public inputs.
A private development reference has exercised the local visible runner, but that observation is not a workflow or benchmark result.
A private simulation development phase was observed on one calibration subject locally and on SERVER26, but the canonical evaluator verdict remains BLOCKED and no hidden calibration gate is claimed.
Development-only mutation counts, false-positive observations, bounded-formal outcomes, and raw coverage metrics are not frozen benchmark results; benchmark readiness is not claimed.
